title: UV Exposure Log Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=uv:exposure
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(location) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many UV exposure log events land each day and how many distinct location values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest UV exposure log records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct location values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much UV exposure log activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
